abstract: Three patients with stage I disease and 3 patients with stage III disease were treated with laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymphnode dissection. The patient was placed in a semilateral position and 5 trocars were introduced through the lateral abdominal wall. After incising the peritoneum along the Toldt line, the colon was reflected medially and the retroperitoneal structures such as the ureter, aorta, inferior vena cava and both renal arteries and veins were exposed. For right-side disease the paracaval and interaortocaval lymphnodes were dissected, and for left-side disease, the interaortocaval and paraaortic lymphnodes were dissected. The procedure was completed successfully on all 6 patients. The average operative time was 3.4 hours for 3 patients with stage I disease and 4.4 hours for 3 patients with stage III disease treated with prior chemotherapy. All patients started to walk and resumed oral intake from the first post-operative day and the average duration to full convalescence was 21 days. Anteriograde ejaculation and erection were preserved in all six patients. Laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymphnode dissection will be a useful technique for management of testicular cancer.
abstract_ja: 病期Iの3例および病期IIIの3例に対し、腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行した。患者は半側臥位とし、外側腹壁から5本のトロカールを挿入した。Toldt線に沿って腹膜を切開後、結腸を内側に反転させ、尿管、大動脈、下大静脈、両側腎動静脈などの後腹膜構造を露出させた。右側病変では傍大静脈および大動脈・大静脈間のリンパ節を郭清し、左側病変では大動脈・大静脈間および傍大動脈のリンパ節を郭清した。6例全例で手術は完遂された。平均手術時間は、病期Iの3例で3.4時間、術前化学療法を受けた病期IIIの3例で4.4時間であった。全患者が術後1日目から歩行を開始し、経口摂取を再開した。完全回復までの平均期間は21日であった。6例全例で順行性射精と勃起機能は温存された。腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清は、精巣がんの治療において有用な手技となると考えられる。
